Adding a quick technical note we should include in the kickoff agenda and in the shared doc:

Proposed technical success criteria (for discussion)
- Latency: 95th percentile <= 250ms for 512-token requests (internal benchmarking on similar model/profile)
- Throughput: sustain 200 concurrent requests during peak test window (burst to 400 acceptable for short periods)
- Quality: baseline BLEU-like pass rate on the shared eval prompts >= 85% (we'll include sample evals)
- Observability: logs + token-level cost visible in console, and webhook for errors

Pre-reqs for env access:
- IP allowlist: list of Redwood egress IPs (we'll provide)
- Test account credentials and a small test dataset (sample prompts)
- Point of contact for infra (Liam) and security (security.team@acme-corp.com)

I'll attach the technical appendix to the shared POC doc during the invite.

—Dylan
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
